_doc: PED ZONES — sidewalk crowds outside downtown. Read by systems/pedestrians.gd (ZONES_PATH) at setup, never in smoke mode. A zone is a POLYLINE of world (x,z) points that IS its peds' sidewalk: they stroll along it the way downtown peds walk a block's rounded-square loop, and everything else (flee, brawl, knockdown, gunfire panic, despawn) is the shared code. Keys: name (probe handle for pedestrians.zone_count), pts [[x,z],...], loop (wrap the last point back to the first), width (m either side of the line a ped may stand on — it is also the panic clamp, so keep it inside the real pavement), cap (max live peds from this zone), y (walking surface height in m; ped feet sit here), min_dist (m: never pop in closer than this to the player — default 50, lowered only for short zones you can otherwise never see populated), outfits (weight table over character_factory's Outfit enum), hat (optional forced hat, applied only when the rolled archetype is WORKER). The shared spawn ring/interval/tries pick zones alongside the downtown cells; when the player is far from every zone, zones simply never qualify. NOTHING may be placed in the smoke corridor x[174,212] z[424,576].

zones.name: cliff_boulevard
zones._note: CEDAR CLIFF — both sidewalks of Juárez Boulevard as one circuit: north side west-to-east, cross at the east end, south side back, cross again. The storefront run is the busiest ground outside downtown. West end stops at x −440: Gilead Bottoms' lot fences run to z 790/810 and its sign posts stand at z 792. East end stops at x 44: the Cliff Lofts lot is fenced from x 58.
